title: Perform a de-clustering intervention
frozenQuestion: After physically removing as much policy adjacency as possible at a state-matched exposure-qualified aggregation peak while preserving the exact value sequence and policy-bearing identities, do native local dynamics reconstruct the lost aggregation faster and more extensively than action-irrelevant matched label shuffles?

scope.sourceConditions: The three repeated_1_10_x10 balanced 50/50 pairwise absent-association S06/S09 anchors.

feasibilityBoundary.exactValueSequenceRule: The ordered value at every position must be byte-identical before and after intervention.
feasibilityBoundary.repeatedInputs: Identities may be permuted only among positions occupied by equal values. This can change policy positions while preserving every positional value.
feasibilityBoundary.uniqueInputs: With one identity per value, exact positional-value preservation permits no nontrivial identity permutation. The 75 unique anchor scenarios receive a structural infeasibility audit and no restoration claim.
feasibilityBoundary.relationToS11: S10 never reassigns policies or values across identities. Broader policy-versus-value shuffles remain reserved for S11.

checkpoint.definition: For each repeated anchor, use the earliest 101-grid progress point attaining the maximum validated S06 condition-mean corrected policy adjacency among progress points at or below 0.75.
checkpoint.reason: S09 established that terminal peak checkpoints have no post-intervention exposure. The cap guarantees at least 25% of the validated native accepted-swap trajectory remains while retaining the highest upstream-only eligible aggregation checkpoint.
checkpoint.targetRule: Intervene immediately after accepted-swap count floor(progress times the scenario's validated S07 native final successful-swap count), before the next activation.
checkpoint.qualification: Bubble+Selection and Insertion+Selection have terminal full-trajectory maxima; their S10 checkpoints are exposure-qualified preterminal peaks, not their global maxima.

declusteringMagnitude.objective: Minimize same-executable-policy edges on the 99-edge open path, equivalently maximize adjacent policy transitions, subject to exact per-value policy counts at the checkpoint.
declusteringMagnitude.solver: Exact binary mixed-integer linear program with transition indicators and equality constraints for each of the ten value strata. A second deterministic SHA-256-addressed linear objective selects one optimum without using continuation outcomes.
declusteringMagnitude.identityRealization: Keep an identity at its position whenever its policy already matches the optimal target. Reassign only mismatched identities among equal-value positions that require their unchanged policy, using deterministic SHA-256 ordering.
declusteringMagnitude.frozenMagnitude: Use the exact attainable minimum in every scenario, not a post hoc percentile or hand-tuned drop. Record raw drop, fraction of attainable drop, identities moved, and total displacement.
declusteringMagnitude.adequacyGate: Median immediate corrected-adjacency drop must be at least 0.10 and at least 90% of scenarios must drop by at least 0.05.

arms.intervention: None; continue the checkpoint state under native policies.
Rebuild an identical continuation object while preserving occupancy, cursor map, counters, ledger, seed, and source runtime key.
Apply the exact within-value identity permutation and carry every Selection cursor with its owning identity.

Apply the same identity permutation; at destinations previously occupied by Selection, transfer that position's cursor to the new Selection identity, reset newly Selection positions to the ascending boundary 0, and remove cursors from non-Selection identities.
Do not move identities or alter executable policies; attach the first matched-null label arrangement to identities at the checkpoint and directly replay it.

matchedNullShuffles.definition: Thirty-two deterministic action-irrelevant label assignments per scenario, carried by unchanged identities on the no-switch continuation.
constraints: exact label counts within every value stratum equal to the executable-policy counts
the same checkpoint same-label edge count as the exact physical de-clustering optimum
no change to occupancy, values, executable policies, Selection cursors, counters, ledger, seed, or runtime key
matchedNullShuffles.generation: Start from the exact optimum and use a SHA-256-addressed Markov chain that swaps opposite labels only within equal-value strata and accepts only arrangements retaining the optimum edge count. Exclude the physical target pattern and require 32 unique arrangements; use outcome-blind randomized exact-solver tie objectives only if the chain lacks support.
matchedNullShuffles.interpretation: These are matched apparent de-clusterings with no action pathway. They control regression and geometry of the aggregation metric; they are not a claim of uniform sampling over all optimum arrangements.

primaryPhysical: exact strict paper Sortedness and non-strict reference Sortedness
immutable identity value, executable policy, direction, fault, and analysis label
activation count, stream counters, ledger, seed, max activations, and source scenario_id
allowedPrimaryChanges: policy arrangement across positions induced only by moving unchanged identities
statePreservation.sensitivityCursorException: Only the explicitly specified Selection cursor reassignment differs from primary. Occupancy and every other preserved field must match the primary intervention.
statePreservation.sham: Every RunState field and every cell field must be exact.
statePreservation.matchedLabels: Only Cell.analysis_label may differ; all transition-relevant fields must be exact.

runtimeAndScheduler.runtimeKey: Every arm retains the source seed and source scenario_id. Modified scenarios are structurally validated under a content ID before restoring the S08/S09 runtime-key fixture.
runtimeAndScheduler.coupling: All arms schedule the same actor identity and, because policies remain identity-fixed, query the same Bubble-side counter address at every common global event index until an arm terminates. Physical intervention changes actor position, not scheduled identity or random address.
runtimeAndScheduler.comparisonClock: Sample 101 common post-checkpoint activation-exposure points through the maximum paired terminal exposure. Carry completed, quiescent, or budget-terminated arms forward as absorbing states; retain accepted-swap progress only as a sensitivity descriptor.

metricsAndEstimands.aggregation: Paper adjacency (same-policy edges divided by n=100) minus the exact 0.49 composition expectation.
metricsAndEstimands.gapClosureCurve: 1 - [A_no(t)-A_decluster(t)] / initialDrop. It is exactly zero immediately after intervention; one means the de-clustered arm has caught the contemporaneous untreated aggregation trajectory.
metricsAndEstimands.matchedNullGapClosure: Replace A_decluster(t) with matched action-irrelevant label adjacency on the unchanged no-switch trajectory, using the same initialDrop denominator.
metricsAndEstimands.recoveryRate: Gap closure at common activation progress 0.10 divided by 0.10.
metricsAndEstimands.recoveryTiming: Earliest common activation progress attaining 0.50 gap closure; missing if never attained. Also report time of maximum recovery.
metricsAndEstimands.recoveryArea: Piecewise-linear integral of positive gap closure.
metricsAndEstimands.nullExcessExtent: Physical recoveryExtent minus maximum of the mean matched-null gap-closure curve.
metricsAndEstimands.nullExcessArea: Physical recoveryArea minus positive area of the mean matched-null gap-closure curve.
metricsAndEstimands.uncertainty: Ten-thousand deterministic paired bootstrap resamples within condition and stratified across conditions; percentile 95% intervals. Condition-level one-sided p-values are BH-adjusted within outcome.
metricsAndEstimands.primaryRule: Identity-cursor physical intervention only. Position-cursor results are completion-sensitive diagnostics carrying forward S09's cursor caveat.

operationalAttractorCriteria.terminology: Use the phrase operational aggregation attractor only if every validity, intervention, completion, restoration, timing, and matched-null-excess gate passes. Never imply biological adhesion, intention, or a state-space proof of a mathematical attractor.
operationalAttractorCriteria.validity: All 75 sources replay S07 exactly; all physical and null assignments satisfy their preservation contracts; no_switch equals sham and matched_label_replay transitions equal no_switch; runtime/scheduler coupling, complete accounting, S01-S09 byte immutability, and S11 absence pass.
operationalAttractorCriteria.intervention: The de-clustering adequacy gate passes and every primary intervention attains the exact solver minimum.
operationalAttractorCriteria.completion: Primary de-clustered completion is at least 95% overall and at least 90% in each condition, with no invariant failures and no more than a five-percentage-point loss from sham.
operationalAttractorCriteria.restoration: The pooled primary recoveryExtent bootstrap lower bound exceeds 0.50; at least two of three condition point estimates exceed 0.50.
operationalAttractorCriteria.timing: At least 70% of primary scenarios attain 0.50 gap closure and the median time-to-half among those scenarios is at most 0.50 common activation exposure.
operationalAttractorCriteria.nullExcess: Pooled bootstrap lower bounds exceed 0.20 for nullExcessExtent and zero for nullExcessArea; at least two of three conditions have positive point estimates for both.
operationalAttractorCriteria.supportive: All operationalAttractorCriteria gates pass; apply the bounded phrase operational aggregation attractor.
operationalAttractorCriteria.null: Validity and intervention pass but one or more restoration, timing, completion, or null-excess gates fail without a precise directional contradiction; do not apply the attractor label.
operationalAttractorCriteria.constrainingOrContradictory: A preservation or validity gate fails, the intervention is infeasible, or the primary de-clustered trajectory is precisely less restorative than the matched null; do not apply the attractor label.

claimBoundaries: S10 tests restoration only in repeated-value balanced pairwise mixtures, because exact value-sequence preservation makes unique-value de-clustering structurally impossible.
The physical intervention moves policy-bearing identities but never changes an identity's value or executable policy.
Identity-owned cursor transfer is the clean-room primary semantics. Position-local cursor transfer is an explicitly non-primary sensitivity and may impair completion, as S09 warned.
Matched label shuffles control an action-irrelevant metric perturbation; they do not represent a neutral physical process or uniform sampling over all optimum arrangements.
A positive recovery response is simulator-local intervention evidence. It does not prove a mathematical attractor, biological affinity, adhesion, cognition, or intention.
S10 does not separate arbitrary policy and value reassignment and does not start S11.
